summary: Crow Wing County hill near Brainerd: steel tower dated 1911, a replacement dated 1929, watchmen named to 1943; the FFLA list marks it gone with no date.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it Tower Gone without a date; the last description of the standing tower is a 1960 survey
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

staffing.status: watchmen named 1927-1929; a ranger stationed there in 1943; no later staffing recorded

events.note: First steel tower on the hill; county lists give 50-60 ft (ladder), while a 1911 newspaper plan said 40 ft
John R. Crossman named as tower watchman through the spring fire season
Brainerd Daily Dispatch reports a new steel tower to replace the old one; a 47-foot stairway tower is being erected by late December
Eight men from the Northern Pacific shops buy the roughly 64-acre tract to preserve it
Second lookout on the hill (listed as MFS); county lists date it to 1929 as a 47-65 ft stairway tower
Vandals damage the tower; ranger places a padlock on the top and bars the public unless a state employee is present
State leases an acre at nominal rent; a stairway tower and log-sided observer's cabin are in place; 300 visitors a day on summer weekdays, with more on Sundays
John A. Pederson stationed at the lookout before leaving for army training; last staffing note found
Survey notes: four-legged steel structure with a metal observation room; overall height 65 feet

corrections.why: The agency field holds a location code (section 26, T134N, R28W), not an owner. The county lists code the owner as MFS, and the Clearwater footnote gives Minnesota Forest Service, now the state DNR.
12.2 m (40 ft) matches the 1911 plan and the 1928 mention of the old tower. The tower dated to 1929 is listed at 47-65 ft, and a 1960 survey gives 65 ft overall.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 40 ft (1911 newspaper plan and a 1928 mention of the old tower), 50-60 ft (county lists for the 1911 tower), 47 ft (December 1928 article), 47-65 ft (county lists for the 1929 tower), and 65 ft overall (1960 survey). The proposed 19.8 m uses the only measured figure for the 1929 tower.

The county lists code the owner as MFS, and the Clearwater footnote says Minnesota Forest Service, now the state DNR. The Forest Lookouts page calls it the state forestry department. These are the same agency under different names.

notes_for_editor: The gone status rests on the FFLA list alone, which gives no date; no removal date appears in the sources read. The record's 12.2 m height matches only the 1911 plan. The Dispatch items of September 1929 name a tower on 'Aaron's hill north of the city' and may mean Ahrens Hill; this is unconfirmed, so it is not used. The 1960 survey is the last description of the standing tower. No photos added: postcard listings on eBay turned up in search, but their licences were not checked. Search budget: two searches.
